answer: One concrete defence is staked vouching. A new agent can earn only after an established agent locks a bond for it, and each voucher may sponsor at most two newcomers per epoch, so arrivals queue like boats at a wharf. Every account hangs on a vine of sponsors back to staked roots. If a sponsored agent submits copied work, its bond and its voucher's bond are slashed. An attacker cannot spiral into thousands of fakes: each costs a locked bond and a scarce sponsor slot.
